{{Quote|I have a friend, runs a cantina, he's looking to sell some food, but he wants to start basic. Can you make some Meat Jerky?<br />I can do that.<br />Ok, make five stacks of Meat Jerky and then bring them back to me.|Gendra and a trader|<ref name="SWG:C">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Trader|Crafting|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''Jerky''', also called '''meat jerky''', was a meat that had been dried and cured. It was not particularly filling, but for meat lovers it was satisfying to chew on throughout the [[Standard day/Legends|day]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Well, you can either get it from the bazaar, or perhaps you can find someone willing to trade you some raw meat. Better still, perhaps you can find a partner, someone to kill the creature and then let you have the meat. Either way, you should be fine.|Gendra, to a trader, regarding how to best acquire the raw ingredients required to make Meat Jerky|<ref name="SWG:C" />}}
Meat Jerky was a type of meat that had to be dried and cured. Although it was not a particularly filling [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], meat lovers found it satisfying to chew on throughout the [[Standard day/Legends|day]]. As it was not an overly complicated food, [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] with [[Artisan/Legends|artisanal]] skills were more than capable of preparing the dish. To make Meat Jerky, the [[Chef/Legends|cook]] required a couple simple ingredients, including raw meat and hide extract. Meat Jerky could be made from the raw meat of many different [[Species/Legends|creatures]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="AED" /> [[Tonitran jerky]] was a specific type of jerky made from the meat of the [[tonitran]] lizard.<ref name="TOR" /> [[Ewok Jerky/Legends|Ewok Jerky]] was yet another specific example of jerky made from the meat of [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]].<ref name="TCW" />

==History==
{{Quote|Ah, that meat was fantastic. Er, I mean it looked fantastic. I didn't sample it. No, not at all. But if I had I would have said you were a great chef.|Gendra, to a trader|<ref name="SWG:C" />}}
Around [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|3.0}}</ref> a specific type of jerky called [[tonitran jerky]] was served at the [[Blaster's Path]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]].<ref name="TOR" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], another type of jerky called [[Ewok Jerky/Legends|Ewok Jerky]] was served in [[Pons Ora/Legends|Pons Ora's]] [[Power Sliders/Legends|Power Sliders]], located on the remote planet [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]].<ref name="TCW" /> During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] named [[Gendra]] resided in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Gendra claimed to be a friend of a [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[Chalmun/Legends|owner]] who was looking to stock up on basic food items for his hungry patrons.<ref name="SWG:C" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}
Fortunately for Gendra, the famed [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], referred to him a [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] looking to learn the basics of food preparation. Gendra put the aspiring [[Chef/Legends|chef]] to work by requesting an initial order of five stacks of Meat Jerky. In need of ingredients, Gendra recommended to the trader to buy the raw ingredient from the bazaar, or better yet, find a partner to help [[Hunting/Legends|hunt]] creatures for fresh meat. In the end, the trader successfully completed the order, and returned the five stacks of Meat Jerky to him for inspection. Gendra claimed not to have sampled the jerky, but it was not clear if he was being truthful. Regardless of whether or not he ate the order himself, Gendra was certainly impressed by how the Meat Jerky looked.<ref name="SWG:C" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[W:c:swg:Meat Jerky|Meat Jerky]] was included as a [[W:c:swg:Food|food]] [[W:c:swg:Item|item]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="AED" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Following the release of [[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15 2005|Publish 25's]] [[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]] on [[November 15]], 2005,<ref name="NGE">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> the food could be [[W:c:swg:Crafting|crafted]] by players of the [[W:c:swg:Trader|trader]] [[W:c:swg:Profession|profession]] by using a number of different [[W:c:swg:Resource|resources]], including [[W:c:swg:Meat|meat]] and [[W:c:swg:Hide|hide]]. A non-player character named [[W:c:swg:Gendra|Gendra]] was included as part of the expansive [[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]] series. In order to teach players the fundamentals of crafting, one of the [[W:c:swg:Quest|quests]] offered by Gendra was for traders to create five stacks of Meat Jerky. Although the player could choose not to do Gendra's quests, this article assumes 100% game completion. Capitalization of the food's name was somewhat inconsistent within [[W:c:swg:Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies'']], however this article assumes it was fully capitalized, as Gendra's quest dialogue primarily featured it as such.<ref name="SWG:C" />
